# A repository with a lock file of 200 random bytes: pass 2 cannot lock it and
# says "invalid lock file", exit code 1; pass 1 takes no lock and passes.
$ restic --cache-dir /tmp/pocketcloud-check-cache --cleanup-cache --retry-lock 30m check --read-data-subset=1/20
--- stdout
using temporary cache in /tmp/pocketcloud-check-cache/restic-check-cache-1122353341
create exclusive lock for repository
--- stderr
Fatal: invalid lock file: LoadRaw(<lock/5a09675764>): invalid data returned

the `unlock --remove-all` command can be used to remove invalid locks. Make sure that no other restic process is accessing the repository when running the command
--- exit 1
